text:
sara_support: Hey team — ACME just opened an escalation: Feb invoice shows ~3.2M tokens billed but our Console 'served tokens' for their org is ~2.1M. They pasted sample request ids: req_7b2f, req_8c3d, req_9a11. They say many of the requests share an identical 120-token prompt prefix. Suspect continuous batching + prefix cache accounting noise. Anyone seen metered >> served like this?

mike_billing: What billing metric is the invoice using? We normally bill on metered_tokens from the metering pipeline (pre-batching). Can you share invoice id and a short repro?

sara_support: Invoice INV-2026-02-198. I ran a quick grep on the prod request logs and pasted a small sample below (sanitized). Notice repeated prefix hashes: prefix_hash=0xabc123 appears in ~4k requests in the period. Logs: 
```
time=2026-02-12T15:11:02Z req=req_7b2f prefix_hash=0xabc123 tokens_in=145 tokens_out=12 served_tokens=157
time=2026-02-12T15:11:03Z req=req_8c3d prefix_hash=0xabc123 tokens_in=145 tokens_out=12 served_tokens=157
```

amit_engineering: Thanks — this matches a class of issues we've seen where metering runs at admission (per-request tokenized length) but the runtime deduplicates work inside continuous batching / prefix KV cache which reduces actual GPU compute. Short version: metered_tokens (what billing pipeline consumes) counts token budget per request before the batch dedupe. served_tokens in Console is computed post-execution (what the model actually emitted or the cache returned). If a batch reuses cached KV for a shared prefix, compute & served token cost can be much lower than the sum of pre-admission token counts.

lia_prod: Can you repro locally? If we can show a deterministic repro we can ask billing to adjust credits for ACME.

amit_engineering: Repro steps I ran (quick):
1) Send 100 concurrent requests with identical 120-token prefix but different short suffixes.
2) Monitor metering logs and runtime traces.
Command (node):
```
// pseudo
for (let i=0;i<100;i++) fetch('/v1/generate',{body: prefix+suffix(i)})
```
Observation: metering pipeline logs 100 * 120 input tokens (metered_tokens +100 * tokens_in) but runtime trace shows most of prefix came from KV cache and GPU token compute was ~20 tokens per request.

mike_billing: That explains the delta. Invoice uses metered_tokens as input to pricing. Console served_tokens is lower. Billing is doing what it's defined to do today (admission-based metering). Is ACME expecting billing to be per-exec GPU work?

sara_support: Customer says they were surprised — their engineering team optimized by moving repeated context to prefix and expected lower cost. They quoted our docs about prefix caching improving costs. Now they're asking for a billing credit or a change in charging.

amit_engineering: Short-term options: 1) Provide a one-time credit while we investigate; 2) Offer to switch ACME to a dedicated capacity config where we can guarantee charge-by-served-tokens with a custom usage adapter (manual mapping). Long-term: change metering to apply batch-level dedupe when computing invoiceable tokens (non-trivial: would need to attribute shared prefix cost across requests in the batch).

lia_prod: For the credit we need a reproducible delta and numbers. Sara — can you ask ACME to run the repro snippet with their keys for a 1-hour window (we can also reproduce in our staging) and paste the metering export and runtime traces?

sara_support: Will do. I've asked for the output and suggested they run the concurrent test. Also offered a small temporary credit pending investigation :thumbsup:.

amit_engineering: Implementation notes if we pursue batch-aware metering: we must move metering after the batch-formation stage to annotate when tokens are deduped by KV/prefix reuse. That requires streaming metering data from runtime to billing (latency + reliability concerns) and a reconciliation job for invoices. Also need to preserve SLA for hosted API (predictable billing).

mike_billing: Filing a billing issue: BI-4682 — "Evaluate batch-dedupe-aware metering for prefix/KV cache". Tagging finance and pricing. For ACME credit: propose credit = invoice_delta - (expected delta for prefix benefit) — need exact numbers.

deploy-bot: deploy complete: metering-pipeline v2.3.1 -> prod at 2026-03-01T03:00:00Z

lia_prod: One more note — docs should be clearer: prefix/KV cache improves runtime compute but does not necessarily reduce invoice tokens under current billing. We'll draft a short blurb for the FAQ.

sara_support: OK I'll collect ACME repro, share logs, and put a request to finance for a provisional credit. Thanks all.
